case_name: Text on screen in a clip
title: Gardener Interview Name Caption
tests: Checks an exact two-line lower third that stays readable and correctly placed over a moving subject.

faults.what: The required dark backing behind the lower third is missing. White lettering sits directly over the garden and her light shirt, reducing contrast as she moves.

judge.summary: The woman smiles and turns toward the camera in a garden with correctly spelled lower-third text, but the required dark caption backing is missing.

must_haves.item: A woman is visibly in a community garden, smiling and turning slightly toward the camera.
must_haves.why: The frames show a smiling woman turning from profile toward the camera among planted beds and garden supports.

must_haves.item: The lower third reads exactly 'Maya Chen' above 'Community Gardener', with no additional text.
must_haves.why: Both lines read exactly as requested, in the correct order, with no other visible text.

must_haves.item: Both lines use legible white lettering on a dark backing at the bottom left, with no clipping.
must_haves.why: The white text is at the bottom left and is not clipped, but there is no visible dark backing.

must_haves.item: The lower third does not cover her face and remains stable and readable as she moves.
must_haves.why: The text stays in the same position below her face and remains readable in the supplied frames, though contrast decreases over her shirt.

must_haves.item: The caption is absent during the opening second and present from approximately second 1 through the end.
must_haves.why: It is absent at 0.9 seconds and present at 2.7, 4.6, and 6.4 seconds, consistent with the requested timing in the available samples.

must_haves.item: The delivered clip is silent, 16:9 and approximately 7 seconds long.
must_haves.why: The frames are widescreen approximately 16:9 and the supplied duration is 7.3 seconds, but silence cannot be verified from still images.
